Grimoire parchment (Grimoire0.png, 3000 x 3000)

Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication), per the project owner (Miguel), 2026-10-29.

parchment.png is the original cropped to (280, 140, 2715, 2865), 60 px outside its inner frame line, and scaled to
1024 x 1146: the line then lies 25 px from each edge, inside the 40 px border slices the panels use (Hud.uss), so text
always sits inside the frame.
